Starting from the displayed Pascaleff-Tonkonog potential W'=sum_{i=k}^n y_i^{-1}+P Q^k, direct symbolic differentiation gives a critical local system with y_1,...,y_k=1/k and the remaining variables 1, critical value n+1. Expanding PQ^k gives the stated simplex vertices. Exact determinant reduction yields normalized volume k^(k-1)(n+1); gcds of edge vectors give a complete K_k of affine-length-k edges on C,P^(1),...,P^(k-1), with every other edge primitive. For k>3 this long-edge incidence cannot occur in a lifted Vianna simplex, whose non-unit edges lie in one triangular face; for k=3 the long triangle has lengths (3,3,3), not a Markov triple. The critical-point Floer criterion then gives non-displaceability. Independent symbolic checks through 3<=k<=n<=7 agreed with the uniform algebraic proof.
